name: Sardine, Corn & Black Bean Rice Skillet
steps: Rinse 1 cup rice and combine with 2 cups water in a pot; bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 min.
While rice cooks, heat a pan over medium heat, add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in drained black beans, corn kernels, and diced carrot; cook 3‑4 min.
Add the canned sardines (break into chunks) and sprinkle cumin, salt, and black pepper; heat through.
Fold the cooked rice into the pan, mixing all ingredients evenly; warm for 2 min.
In a separate small skillet, fry the egg sunny‑side up and place on top of the rice mixture.
image_prompt: flaked canned sardines mixed with golden rice, bright yellow corn kernels, glossy black beans, and a fried egg on top, with diced orange carrot and a sprinkle of black pepper
